Quick Start Guide

Version 1.0 — August 2026

Welcome

You just bought a Notion system built for how your brain actually works. No rigid schedules. No shame. Just templates and guides designed around dopamine, not discipline.

This guide walks you through setting everything up. Budget 30 minutes. Do it once. Then get back to work.

Before you start: Open Notion in a browser tab. Have your Google account ready. Grab coffee. This is the last productivity setup you'll ever do.

Setup in 4 steps

Step 1 of 4

Set up the Money Tracker

Open dopakit-money-tracker.xlsx in Google Sheets (File → Import). Rename it "Dopakit Money". Bookmark it. This takes 5 minutes and you'll use it every month.

Step 2 of 4

Build your Notion workspace

Open notion-template-structure.md. Follow it section by section. Create the pages and databases exactly as described. Don't skip. Don't customize yet. Just build the skeleton.

Step 3 of 4

Personalize it

Now make it yours. Add your real clients to the Client Project database. Fill in your energy peak. Set up your first body doubling session. Add 3 tasks to today's dashboard. This is where it becomes YOUR system.

Step 4 of 4

Read the Body Doubling Guide

Open body-doubling-guide.md. Read it once. Schedule your first session this week. Even one session makes a difference.

Your first week

Here is exactly what to do each day. Follow this. Don't improvise. Trust the system for one week.

DayAction
Day 1Complete the 4-step setup above. Add 3 tasks to today's dashboard. Do them. Check them off.
Day 2Use the dashboard. Add your tasks in the morning. Do a focus sprint (25 min work + 5 min break). Earn one reward from your dopamine menu.
Day 3Try the task breakdown template. Pick one complex task. Break it into 6 small steps. Do step 1.
Day 4Schedule a body doubling session for next week. Read the guide section on finding partners. Send one invite.
Day 5Open the Money Tracker. Log this week's income. Check your tax set-aside amount. Relax — the system is working.
Day 6Use the Content System. Pick one idea from your parking lot. Write a messy first draft. Don't edit. Just write.
Day 7Sunday reset ritual. Answer the 4 weekly planner questions. Review your "did the thing" log. Celebrate what got done.
Bad brain day? Open the Reset Protocols. Follow the Bad Brain Day procedure. Some days your brain won't cooperate. That's fine. The system has a plan for that too.

Common questions

I missed a day. Should I start over?
No. Pick up where you left off. The system is flexible. It was built for brains that don't do linear.

I don't like one of the modules. Can I skip it?
Yes. The modules work independently. Skip what doesn't fit. Use what helps.

I need help.
Email support@dopakit.com. Real human. Real answers. Usually within 24 hours.
